offers_products.reason: Sells hamburgers, chicken sandwiches, fries and beverages as food products through restaurants.

offers_services.reason: Franchisor collecting royalties and franchise fees; also operates restaurants serving customers; mainly franchising.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Fast-food restaurant customers buy burgers, drive-thru and delivery meals.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Franchisees are businesses paying royalties and fees; also buy supply through the system.

recurring_revenue.reason: Franchise royalties and repeat restaurant purchases of low-cost meals recur continually.

cyclical_demand.reason: Low-priced fast food holds up in downturns, though dining out is somewhat discretionary.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a small, frequent meal purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for food and brand; franchise royalties rely on brand and system, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households; franchisees are mostly small-to-mid operators.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly franchised, asset-light royalty model, though some company restaurants and real estate leases exist.

notes: Mostly franchised; consumers buy meals while franchisees are the corporate-level customers.
